_README: Review every entry before running convert.
Set 'atlas_id' to the correct entity, or null to skip the label.
'status' is advisory; convert reads 'atlas_id' only. 'procedural_badge' is stamped onto the converted manifest by this script's --stamp.
subject: ct_vhm_forearm_v2

entries.procedural_badge: Rule-based segmentation from his own cryosection photographs (Visible Human male, 0.33 mm, instances 1575-1819): position-rule markers relative to his radius/ulna and a 3-D compact marker watershed on the pale fascial septa; its boundaries run on a visible pale septum at 28 % of shared slices, elsewhere they are rule lines, not traced anatomy. Measured volume 56.6 cm3 vs expectation 90.5 cm3 (repository architecture volume 21.8 cm3, PCSA x fascicle length, size-normalised to his forearm total per Holzbaur et al. 2007). Only the part between his radial-head and distal-radius planes is segmented.
